🖥 President Pezeshkian officially welcomes Iraqi prime minister in Tehran

📌 Tehran, IRNA – Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian has officially welcomed Iraqi Prime Minister Ali Faleh al-Zaidi in Tehran, as the two sides prepare to discuss bilateral relations and sign cooperation agreements.

The official welcoming ceremony was held on Thursday at the Sa’dabad Cultural-Historical Complex after al-Zaidi arrived in Tehran at the head of a high-ranking delegation earlier in the day.
​
Following the national anthems of Iran and Iraq and an inspection of the honor guard, members of the two countries’ official delegations were introduced.
​
The Iraqi prime minister is scheduled to hold a private bilateral meeting with President Pezeshkian, followed by a joint meeting between the two countries’ high-ranking delegations.
​
The two sides are also expected to sign documents aimed at expanding bilateral cooperation during the official visit.
